table_metadata: This table tracks daily inventory consumption across three restaurant outlets (REST_A, REST_B, REST_C) of the Sarova hotel. It records the quantity of each SKU consumed, its item group category, and stock risk indicators. The table is used to analyze food and beverage demand, outlet-level consumption patterns, seasonality impact, and potential stockout risks.

DATE_COL.description: Date when the inventory consumption was recorded

OCCUPANCY.description: Hotel occupancy percentage for the corresponding date used to correlate guest demand with consumption

REVENUE.description: Total hotel revenue for the corresponding date used for demand analysis

ITEM_GROUP.description: Category of inventory item used for procurement and consumption analysis

ITEM_NAME.description: Specific inventory product or SKU consumed by hotel outlets

TOTAL_ITEM_CONSUMED.description: Total quantity of the SKU consumed on the given date across outlets

SEASONALITY_INDEX.description: Seasonality factor used to measure demand variation across time periods

QUARTER.description: Quarter derived from the consumption date

YEAR.description: Year derived from the consumption date

OUTLET_A_CONSUMPTION.description: Quantity of the SKU consumed in restaurant outlet A

OUTLET_B_CONSUMPTION.description: Quantity of the SKU consumed in restaurant outlet B

OUTLET_C_CONSUMPTION.description: Quantity of the SKU consumed in restaurant outlet C

STOCKOUT_CATEGORY.description: Stock availability risk classification based on consumption patterns

MONTH.description: Month derived from the consumption date for seasonal analysis

DATA_TYPE.description: Determines whether the data is forcasted or historical
